records.title: Toward the Connection Between Activation Sparsity and Flat Minima
records.reason: Derives that MLP activation sparsity in trained transformers equals a ratio involving loss-landscape flatness; an explanatory training-dynamics theory with no exploitable inference mechanism.

records.title: Feature Alignment Determines Fusion Strategy: A Comparative Study of Cross-Attention and Concatenation in Multimodal Learning
records.reason: Controlled Flickr8k study showing feature alignment quality decides whether concatenation beats cross-attention for multimodal fusion, with sample-complexity theory; an empirical fusion study.

records.title: ChronoStitch: Training-Free Composition of Visual KV Memories for Long-Horizon Temporal Reasoning
records.reason: ChronoStitch composes independently stored per-chunk visual KV caches by re-basing post-rotary keys onto a global three-axis multimodal RoPE coordinate system, enabling training-free KV memory reuse for long-video question answering.

records.title: MoSSGate: Memory-Modulated State-Space Gating for Skin Lesion Segmentation
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a state-space gating module for skin lesion segmentation, a medical image segmentation application, with no LLM inference-system subject.

records.title: Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding
records.reason: Sprout builds a temporal-tree video memory incrementally while answering questions, avoiding full-video offline memory construction for MLLMs; an agentic video-understanding framework motivated by inference cost but centered on a task pipeline.

records.title: Balancing Memory Pathways: Analyzing and Improving Memory Utilization in Hybrid LMs
records.reason: Analyzes attention-versus-recurrent memory pathway use in hybrid LMs and adds an auxiliary loss during supervised fine-tuning to rebalance them; training/analysis of model internals.

records.title: Compaction-Aware Reinforcement Learning For Ascend Triton Kernel Generation
records.reason: ATRL is a compaction-aware GRPO post-training method for LLM agents that generate Ascend Triton kernels, with a profiling-feedback harness; an RL training method for kernel-generation agents.

records.title: GUIFlow: Temporal Redundancy-Aware Incremental Inference for GUI Agents
records.reason: GUIFlow performs full-pipeline incremental inference for GUI agents by position-aligning and injecting historical KV states, selectively updating current-observation states from change signals, and reusing earlier action responses as speculative drafts.

records.title: From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory
records.reason: Anchor tests candidate agent memories by replaying their source decisions before retention, improving ALFWorld/WebShop success under a frozen policy; an agent experience-learning method, not inference execution.

records.title: Attention Instruction: Amplifying Attention in the Middle via Prompting
records.reason: Shows prompting with attention instructions can redirect LLM attention to middle-context segments in multi-document QA; a prompting/position-bias study with no system mechanism.

records.title: QUITO: Accelerating Long-Context Reasoning through Query-Guided Context Compression
records.reason: QUITO computes question-to-context attention with a trigger token and filters context under a length budget, a query-guided context compression method that reduces reasoning complexity and computation cost for in-context learning.

records.title: Linear Attention with Global Context: A Multipole Attention Mechanism for Vision and Physics
records.reason: MANO casts attention as a multipole n-body interaction achieving linear time/memory, validated on image classification and Darcy-flow physics simulation; an efficient-attention architecture aimed at vision/physics, not LLM inference.

records.title: PALM: A Efficient Performance Simulator for Tiled Accelerators with Large-scale Model Training
records.reason: PALM is an event-driven performance simulator for tiled accelerators that models pipeline/tensor parallelism for both training and inference mapping; a design-space simulator led by training use cases.

records.title: Subquadratic Algorithms and Hardness for Attention with Any Temperature
records.reason: Characterizes when subquadratic attention algorithms exist for arbitrary softmax temperature under SETH, with polylog dependence on entry size; complexity theory for attention computation without a systems implementation.

records.title: Accelerated Synchronous Model Parallelism Using Cooperative Process for Training Compute-Intensive Models
records.reason: Accelerates synchronous model parallelism for training compute-intensive models via cooperative prediction and synchronization steps that hide GPipe-style bubbles; a training method.

records.title: scFusionTTT: Single-cell transcriptomics and proteomics fusion with Test-Time Training layers
records.reason: Title explicitly concerns fusion of single-cell transcriptomics and proteomics data with test-time training layers, a single-cell bioinformatics application.

records.title: MixANT: Observation-Dependent Memory Propagation for Stochastic Dense Action Anticipation
records.reason: MixANT uses a mixture of input-dependent forget-gate (A) matrices in state-space models for stochastic dense anticipation of human activities on 50Salads/Breakfast/Assembly101; an activity-prediction task architecture.

records.title: Optimization of reduction kernel based on Triton compiler
records.reason: Optimizes Triton compiler code generation for reduction kernels using warp-shuffle intra-warp processing and FP16 data packing, reducing shared-memory usage and improving parallel efficiency of operators used in training and inference.

records.title: Meta-Embeddings Based On Self-Attention
records.reason: Duo is a self-attention meta-embedding model evaluated on text classification and WMT machine translation; a 2020 NLP representation model, not inference systems.

records.title: Mathematical Formalism for Memory Compression in Selective State Space Models
records.reason: Develops an information-theoretic (mutual information, rate-distortion) formalism for memory compression in selective state space models; mathematical theory without an implemented inference mechanism.

records.title: HyperPipe: Bridging Heterogeneous GPUs for Accelerated Large-Scale Model Training
records.reason: HyperPipe automatically selects hybrid parallel strategies to accelerate large foundation-model training across heterogeneous GPUs; a training framework.

records.title: A Novel Knowledge Tracing Model Based on Collaborative Multi-Head Attention
records.reason: Proposes a collaborative multi-head attention knowledge tracing model with focal loss for modeling student knowledge states in online education; an education application model.

records.title: Cortical-SSM: A Deep State Space Model for EEG and ECoG Motor Imagery Decoding
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a state space model for EEG and ECoG motor imagery decoding, a brain-computer-interface/medical signal application.

records.title: Training-free Token Reduction for Vision Mamba
records.reason: MTR is a training-free token reduction framework for Vision Mamba driven by a structure-aware importance score; it compresses vision-model inference, adjacent to but not LLM/VLM inference.

records.title: Mitigating Visual Context Degradation in Large Multimodal Models: A Training-Free Decoupled Agentic Framework
records.reason: DRP decouples an LLM reasoner from an LMM perceiver so visual evidence is re-queried during long reasoning chains, fixing visual grounding drift; a reasoning-quality framework, not efficiency.

records.title: RepoFusion-in-Decoder: Efficient Cross-File Code Completion via Lightweight Encoder Fusion
records.reason: RepoFusion-in-Decoder extends a frozen decoder-only code LM with a lightweight encoder and cross-attention so cross-file code chunks are encoded and cached independently, substantially reducing prefill time for repository-level code completion.

records.title: AdaptServe: Auto-Scalable DL Serving with Dynamic Model Parallelism
records.reason: AdaptServe is a DL serving system combining ILP-based parallel replica placement with deep-RL runtime replica management under dynamic model parallelism, targeting throughput, scalability and latency for online inference.

records.title: GA-LoftQ: Gradient-Aware Alternating Least Squares Framework for LoRA Fine-Tuning Quantization
records.reason: GA-LoftQ jointly optimizes quantized weights and LoRA matrices via gradient-aware alternating least squares for low-bit (down to 2-bit) fine-tuning; its quantization is bound to the fine-tuning stage rather than inference deployment.

records.title: Class Importance Consistency Matters: Efficient Model Pruning for Long-Tailed Recognition Models
records.reason: CIC pruning uses class-importance consistency and class-wise batch sampling to prune long-tailed image recognition models; a computer-vision pruning application.

records.title: Effective Data Balancing and Fine-Tuning Techniques for Medical sLLMs in Resource-Constrained Domains
records.reason: Presents a QLoRA/FSDP/sequence-packing fine-tuning pipeline for medical small LLMs (MedGemma 4B, LLaMA 3.3 70B) studying multilingual data balance; medical-domain fine-tuning, not inference systems.

records.title: SANSformers: Self-Supervised Forecasting in Electronic Health Records with Attention-Free Models
records.reason: Title explicitly presents attention-free self-supervised forecasting models for electronic health records, a healthcare application domain.

records.title: Efficient Sparse Training with Structured Dropout
records.reason: SparseDrop is a structured, hardware-friendly dropout variant with a CUDA implementation that speeds up training while preserving regularization; a training technique.

records.title: Improving QA Efficiency with DistilBERT: Fine-Tuning and Inference on mobile Intel CPUs
records.reason: Fine-tunes DistilBERT for SQuAD question answering and reports 0.12 s/question inference on a mobile Intel CPU; a small QA application study whose inference content is only timing measurement.

records.title: Memory Determines Learning Direction: A Theory of Gradient-Based Optimization in State Space Models
records.reason: Provides a theory of SSM learning dynamics showing memory capacity trades accuracy against length and that S4 equals a diagonal variant; training-dynamics theory.

records.title: CIMple: Standard-cell SRAM-based CIM with LUT-based split softmax for attention acceleration
records.reason: CIMple is a fully digital standard-cell SRAM compute-in-memory accelerator with LUT-based split softmax designed to accelerate self-attention for LLM deployment on resource-constrained edge devices.

records.title: Style Amnesia: Investigating Speaking Style Degradation and Mitigation in Multi-Turn Spoken Language Models
records.reason: Documents style amnesia: spoken language models fail to maintain instructed speaking style over multi-turn dialogue, evaluated on five SLMs; a capability evaluation study.

records.title: TwinRouterBench: Fast Static and Live Dynamic Evaluation for Realistic Agentic LLM Routing
records.reason: TwinRouterBench is a step-level benchmark (static prefixes plus a live harness) for evaluating LLM routers in agentic workloads by tier labels and token costs; evaluation infrastructure for routing rather than a serving mechanism itself.

records.title: LIDL: LLM Integration Defect Localization via Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Multi-Agent Analysis
records.reason: LIDL localizes integration defects in LLM-integrated software using a code knowledge graph and multi-agent analysis of prompts, APIs and configurations; software-engineering tooling.

records.title: SafeCodeRL: Security-Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Trustworthy LLM-Generated IoT/CPS Software
records.reason: SafeCodeRL combines multi-agent collaboration with security-constrained reinforcement learning to generate trustworthy LLM-written IoT/CPS software; a secure code-generation framework, not inference systems.

records.title: A Sensitivity Analysis of Multi-Event Audio Grounding in Audio LLMs
records.reason: Large-scale sensitivity analysis of multi-event audio grounding and false alarms in four audio LLMs over 500K queries; a capability/reliability evaluation.

records.title: A Unified Spoken Language Model with Injected Emotional-Attribution Thinking for Human-like Interaction
records.reason: Trains a unified spoken language model with injected emotional-attribution thinking via two-stage speech-text alignment and joint optimization for the HumDial emotional-intelligence benchmark; a speech model capability paper.

records.title: Prefix-Safe Bayesian Belief Tracking for LLM Reasoning Reliability:Separating Calibration from Ranking
records.reason: Sequential Bayesian Belief Tracking estimates prefix-conditioned eventual success of LLM reasoning traces for reliability, separating calibration from ranking; an inference-time monitoring method whose aim is reliability estimation, not inference efficiency.

records.title: CaRE Compute-aware Remasking Evaluation Protocol for Masked Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: CaRE is a compute-aware evaluation protocol that standardizes number of function evaluations and stochasticity to audit remasking strategies in masked diffusion LMs; evaluation methodology.

records.title: Pre-trained transformers: an empirical comparison
records.reason: Empirical comparison and reproducibility survey of five pre-trained transformer models across NLP tasks; a survey/comparison with no inference-system content.

records.title: A survey of transformer networks for time series forecasting
records.reason: Systematic survey of transformer networks for time series forecasting across finance, healthcare and energy; an application-domain survey.

records.title: Perspectives and Prospects on Transformer Architecture for Cross-Modal Tasks with Language and Vision
records.reason: Reviews milestones and prospects of transformer architectures for vision-language cross-modal tasks; a review article with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Teaching Language Models to Critique via Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: CTRL trains LLM critic models by reinforcement learning so their feedback improves a fixed code generator; a training framework (test-time critique-revision is a downstream use).

records.title: Limits of Deep Learning: Sequence Modeling through the Lens of Complexity Theory
records.reason: Proves complexity-theoretic limits of one-layer SSMs and transformers on function composition and evaluates the resulting degradation; a limitations/theory study.

records.title: Finding the Law: Enhancing Statutory Article Retrieval via Graph Neural Networks
records.reason: Title explicitly concerns enhancing statutory article retrieval with graph neural networks, a legal text retrieval application.

records.title: KNN-SSD: Enabling Dynamic Self-Speculative Decoding via Nearest Neighbor Layer Set Optimization
records.reason: KNN-SSD dynamically matches skipped-layer sets to input domains via K-nearest-neighbor search in self-speculative decoding, recovering acceleration lost to domain shift with 1.3-1.6x inference speedup.
